caption: The drawing depicts a beaded and textile strap, possibly a decorative or functional garment accessory. The strap is shown in a U-shape and consists of three main sections: the top section and two longer vertical sections. The top section and the upper parts of the vertical sections are richly decorated with a floral motif that includes red, pink, yellow, and white flowers with green leaves on a pale, possibly white or cream background. The decorative area is bordered by a thin line of green stitching. Below the floral decoration, the lower part of each vertical section transitions into a ribbed or woven segment of a beige color, and these segments end in leather or leather-like tabs that are deep reddish-brown. The inner lining of the top section is a light tan or beige textile material. The overall background of the image is a plain, light beige color. There is also a small, handwritten inscription in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Suspender
